prompt_template.system: You are a biomedical expert. Output answer code only.
prompt_template.human:
{text}
You are biomedical expert, refer to above biomedical article, please give answer based on below conditions:
Assumptions:
1.1 if 'patient had/exhibited {tail} on the Xth day of {head} treatment', please do not use it and find other reason.
1.2 if 'difference did not reach statistical significance compared to groups' appeared, please do not use it and find other reason.
Conditions:
1. if the article gave the conclusion that the interaction between {head} and another induce {tail} or {head} induce {tail}, answer 1
2. else if the article mentioned '{head} is in development of '{tail}', answer 2
3. else if the article mentioned {tail} was reported in the percentage of patients because of {head}, answer 3
4.else if the article mentioned '{head}' increase in resistance to anti-{tail} drugs or drug resistance phenomenon, answer 4
5.else if the article mentioned '{head} is high or low in {tail}, answer 5.
6.else if {head} represent a change or oscillations, answer 6.
7.else if {head} is an extract, answer 7.
8.else if {head} is {tail} marker, answer 8.
9.else if {head} and {tail} have no correlation or therapeutic, answer 9.
10.else if {tail} in this article does not represent a disease but a cell or cell line, answer 10. 
11.else if the article clearly mentioned '{head}' is  mediating/attenuating/treating/therapeutic to '{tail}', answer 11.
DO NOT output any other message.
